description: THE SEATTLE TIMES: For the open state House seat in the 31st District, Republican Drew Stokesbary of Auburn is the candidate most likely to be a voice for fiscal responsibility. The incumbent, Cathy Dahlquist, is vacating the seat to run for state Senate. Stokesbary is an attorney who works as an aide to Metropolitan King … Continued
